from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
import json,hashlib,time,resource,signal,sys
ROOT=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'code'))
import classification_plane_m2_eight_hf_review as Q
import classification_plane_m4_special_review as H
from classification_minimal_quartic_review import LaurentRing
JOB='research/classification/jobs/plane_m2_triangle_h21_fraction_crosscheck.json'
OUT='reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_M2_TRIANGLE_H21_FRACTION_CROSSCHECK_20261108.json'
started=time.monotonic();signal.alarm(180);resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(3072*1024**2,)*2)
contract=json.loads((ROOT/JOB).read_text())
for b in contract['exact_inputs_and_hashes']:assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/b['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==b['sha256'],b['path']
assert not(ROOT/OUT).exists()
old=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_M2_TRIANGLE_DOUBLE_21_20261107.json').read_text());new=json.loads((ROOT/'reports/CLASSIFICATION_PLANE_M2_TRIANGLE_H21_WHOLE_SOURCE_20261108.json').read_text())
B1=list(map(H.mat,[old['full30_weight1_basis']]))[0];B2=H.mat(old['full9_weight2_basis'])
PAIRS=H.PAIRS;COORDS=('a','b','c','u','v')
def idmat(n):return[[F(i==j)for j in range(n)]for i in range(n)]
def matrix(M):return H.mat(M)
def shiftmat(R,sig,sign=1):
 M=[[R.constant(i==j)for j in range(5)]for i in range(5)]
 for i in range(3):
  for j in range(2):M[i][3+j]=R.scale(sig[2*i+j],sign)
 return M
def weight(R,P,k):return Q.skew(R,{ij:{e:c for e,c in P[ij].items()if e[R.n+3]+e[R.n+4]-sum(i>=3 for i in ij)==k}for ij in PAIRS})
def coeff(R,P,ex):return{e[:R.n]+(0,)*5:c for e,c in P.items()if e[R.n:]==ex}
def canonical1(R,P):
 xs=[R.variable(n)for n in COORDS];Y=[{}for _ in range(5)];g=[]
 for normal in(3,4):
  for i in range(3):
   ex=[0]*5;ex[normal]=2;z=R.scale(coeff(R,P[i,normal],tuple(ex)),-1);g.append(z);Y[i]=R.add(Y[i],R.mul(z,xs[normal]))
 G=Q.wedge(R,xs,Y);C=Q.plus(R,P,Q.skew(R,{ij:R.scale(G[ij],-1)for ij in PAIRS}))
 return C,g

def fromvectors(R,base,values):
 return Q.skew(R,{ij:R.add(*(R.scale(R.mul(values[j],{(0,)*R.n+e:F(base[j][k])}),1)for j in range(len(base))for k,(pair,e)in enumerate(H.COLS)if pair==ij and F(base[j][k])))for ij in PAIRS})
def coordinates(R,P,base):
 vv=Q.vec(R,P);out=[]
 for row in base:
  entries=[(i,v)for i,v in enumerate(row)if v];assert len(entries)==1 and entries[0][1]==1
  out.append(vv[entries[0][0]])
 Q.ck(Q.vec(R,fromvectors(R,base,out)),vv,'canonical whole basis decomposition')
 return out
records=[]
for rec,prior in zip(new['cases'],old['cases']):
 assert rec['r']==prior['r'];rval=F(rec['r']);K=H.transpose(H.mat(prior['full30_weight1_kernel']));k=len(K[0]);C=matrix(rec['complete_source_change_matrix']);Ci=matrix(rec['complete_global_source_inverse'])
 Q.ck(Q.mm(C,Ci),idmat(k),'C right inverse');Q.ck(Q.mm(Ci,C),idmat(k),'C left inverse');Q.ck(H.det(C),F(rec['constant_source_determinant']),'constant determinant')
 # Reconstruct the complete finite push in ALL six shear variables.
 T=LaurentRing(tuple('sigma'+str(i)for i in range(6)),COORDS);sig=[T.variable(n)for n in T.names[:6]];P0=Q.basis(T,prior['full150_P0'])
 moved=Q.push(T,P0,shiftmat(T,sig),shiftmat(T,sig,-1));P1,g=canonical1(T,weight(T,moved,1));vals=coordinates(T,P1,B1)
 S=matrix(rec['complete_shear_30by6']);expect=[T.add(*(T.scale(sig[j],S[i][j])for j in range(6)))for i in range(30)];Q.ck(vals,expect,'all-six finite shear exact')
 ind=rec['independent_shear_indices'];res=rec['residual_original_kernel_indices'];assert len(ind)==6
 A=[[S[i][j]for j in ind]+[K[i][j]for j in res]for i in range(30)];Q.ck(Q.mm(K,C),A,'actual source K C equals fullshear+allresidual')
 free=rec['K1_free_coordinate_indices'];Q.ck([K[i]for i in free],idmat(k),'complete original K1 free identity')
 Q.ck(Q.mm(H.mat(prior['full350by30_J1']),K),[[F(0)]*k for _ in range(350)],'old whole original rows times K')
 # Simultaneously ALL K1 alpha parameters and ALL raw nine P2 coefficients.
 pars=tuple('alpha'+str(i)for i in range(k))+tuple('rawq'+str(i)for i in range(9));R=LaurentRing(pars,COORDS);p=R.parse
 alpha=[p('alpha'+str(i))for i in range(k)];rq=[p('rawq'+str(i))for i in range(9)];kvals=[R.add(*(R.scale(alpha[j],K[i][j])for j in range(k)))for i in range(30)]
 P=Q.plus(R,Q.basis(R,prior['full150_P0']),fromvectors(R,B1,kvals),fromvectors(R,B2,rq));newcoords=[R.add(*(R.scale(alpha[j],Ci[i][j])for j in range(k)))for i in range(k)]
 ishear=[{}for _ in range(6)]
 for at,j in enumerate(ind):ishear[j]=R.scale(newcoords[at],-1)
 Q.ck(ishear,list(map(p,rec['full_actual_inverse_shear'])),'complete actual inverse shear')
 moved=Q.push(R,P,shiftmat(R,ishear),shiftmat(R,ishear,-1));Q.ck(weight(R,moved,0),Q.basis(R,prior['full150_P0']),'P0 all parameters fixed')
 can,gg=canonical1(R,weight(R,moved,1));resvals=[R.add(*(R.scale(newcoords[6+n],K[i][j])for n,j in enumerate(res)))for i in range(30)]
 Q.ck(can,fromvectors(R,B1,resvals),'all original K1 inverse residual equality');Q.ck(gg,list(map(p,rec['full_Euler_weight1_gauge_coefficients'])),'all Euler six coefficients')
 qnew=coordinates(R,weight(R,moved,2),B2);shifts=[R.add(z,R.scale(t,-1))for z,t in zip(qnew,rq)]
 Q.ck(shifts,list(map(p,rec['all9_P2_triangular_shifts'])),'ALL9 exact triangular P2 shift')
 assert all(not any(e[k:k+9])for z in shifts for e in z)
 # Every normalized original source, before AND after the full affine P2
 # solution. Pivot P2 variables are not assumed zero or homogeneous.
 rn=tuple(rec['normalized_residual_parameters']);R=LaurentRing(rn+tuple('q'+str(i)for i in range(9)),COORDS);p=R.parse;rr=[p(n)for n in rn]
 P0=Q.basis(R,prior['full150_P0']);P1=fromvectors(R,B1,[R.add(*(R.scale(rr[n],K[i][j])for n,j in enumerate(res)))for i in range(30)])
 Q.ck(P1,Q.tensor(R,rec['normalized_P1']),'full normalized K1')
 fullraw=Q.plus(R,P0,P1,fromvectors(R,B2,[p('q'+str(i))for i in range(9)]))
 m='r1'if rval==-1 else'r0';square=p(str(F(4,3)/rval)+'*'+m+'**2')
 Q.ck(Q.jvec(R,Q.jac(R,fullraw))[279],square,'UNELIMINATED all9 row279 square')
 cert=prior['J2_certificate'];M=H.mat(prior['full350by9_J2']);rows,cols=cert['rows'],cert['columns'];d=H.det([[M[i][j]for j in cols]for i in rows]);Q.ck(d,F(rec['P2_same_minor_determinant']),'same P2 full minor')
 qvals=[p(rec['P2_solution'].get('q'+str(i),'q'+str(i)))for i in range(9)]
 P=Q.plus(R,P0,P1,fromvectors(R,B2,qvals));Q.ck(P,Q.tensor(R,rec['normalized_complete_source']),'all150 affine P2 source')
 J=Q.jvec(R,Q.jac(R,P));Q.ck(J,list(map(p,rec['all350_original_Jacobi_after_affine_P2'])),'all350 full affine originalJacobi');Q.ck(J[54],square,'original row54 square');Q.ck(J[279],square,'original row279 square')
 D=Q.actual(R,P);Q.ck(D,p(rec['actual_D']),'full signed actualPf')
 mzero=Q.skew(R,{ij:Q.zero_params(R,P[ij],[m])for ij in PAIRS})
 assert all(e[R.n+3]>=1 for j in(0,1,2,4)for e in mzero[3,j]),'whole u-row divisibility'
 Dz=Q.actual(R,mzero);Q.ck(Dz,Q.zero_params(R,D,[m]),'mzero actual specialization')
 assert all(e[R.n+3]>=1 for e in Dz),'ALLfive signed Pf u factor'
 records.append(dict(r=str(rval),actual_shear_rank=6,complete_K1_and_six_actual_shear_constant_inverse=True,all_original_K1_plus_raw9_simultaneous_push_and_Euler_gauge=True,all9_P2_global_polynomial_triangular_inverse=True,same_complete_affine_P2_and_all350_verified=True,uneliminated_original_row279=str(F(4,3)/rval)+'*'+m+'^2',full_homogeneous_P2_and_extra_r_minus1_direction_retained=True,mzero_full_u_row_divisibility=True,signed_actual_D_u_factor=True,whole_irreducible_quintic_empty=True));print('Fraction triangle',rval,'PASS',flush=True)
result=dict(task_id='E_reduced_nonnormal',all_passed=True,scope='Alternate standard-library Fraction reconstruction of the same-author SymPy producer whole10 sources. This is independent arithmetic implementation, NOT a separate-author mathematical review. All exact source/inverse/full9/original350/square/Pf certificates reconstructed; pure original coefficient proof and earlier finite-root completeness are stated separately.',cases=records,no_producer_or_CAS_import=True,new_M1_point_profile_wall_or_jet_count=0,input_bindings=contract['exact_inputs_and_hashes'],inline_source=contract['inline_source'],inline_source_sha256=contract['inline_source_sha256'],seconds=time.monotonic()-started,maximum_RSS_KiB=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss)
with(ROOT/OUT).open('x')as f:json.dump(result,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:result[k]for k in('all_passed','seconds','maximum_RSS_KiB')}))
